mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chat_message ( chat_message_seq, room_id, sender, content ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{sender}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_message_seq AS messageId, room_id AS roomId, sender, content, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM tbl_chat_message WHERE chat_message_seq = #{messageId}

SELECT chat_message_seq AS messageId, room_id AS roomId, sender, content, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM tbl_chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY chat_message_seq ASC
